# Orchestrator
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Delegate workers, iterate until complete, and return full test logs to this orchestrator.

# Orchestrator
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Delegate workers for at most 3 iterations. Each worker returns a compact schema with evidence paths. Checkpoint a bounded summary schema containing objective and scope, approved decisions, progress, blockers and open choices, obligation IDs and evidence paths, plus the next decision after every iteration.

# Flow
Run preflight, discovery, planning, build, and verification. Dispatch a worker and inject the complete stdout and stderr into the coordinator context. Limit to 2 attempts and checkpoint each pass.

# Flow
Run preflight, discovery, planning, build, and verification. Delegate a worker for at most 2 attempts. Write full logs to an out-of-band file; return only a bounded summary and evidence path. Checkpoint each pass.

# Lead
Preflight and discover, then plan, build, and verify. Delegate agents and return all findings and tool output to the lead. Run at most 2 passes with a checkpoint.

# Lead
Preflight and discover, then plan, build, and verify. Delegate agents. Return a bounded result schema with decision, evidence path, and blocker. Run at most 2 passes with a checkpoint.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, verify. Delegate workers. Re-run discovery from scratch every iteration for at most 3 iterations. Workers return a compact summary. Checkpoint a bounded summary schema containing objective and scope, approved decisions, progress, blockers and open choices, obligation IDs and evidence paths, plus the next decision.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Delegate a worker with a compact return schema. Retry until tests pass.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Delegate a worker with a compact return schema. Retry at most 2 times. Stop successfully when tests pass; on final failure return the failure summary and escalate. If the failure signature is unchanged, stop early and escalate. Checkpoint a bounded summary schema containing objective and scope, approved decisions, progress, blockers and open choices, obligation IDs and evidence paths, plus the next decision.

# Flow
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Iterate with delegated workers until complete; workers return a bounded summary.

# Flow
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Iterate at most 4 times with delegated workers; workers return a bounded summary. Compact into a bounded summary schema containing objective and scope, approved decisions, progress, blockers and open choices, obligation IDs and evidence paths, plus the next decision after each iteration.

# Lookup
Read the named file and answer the narrow question. Return the citation.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, verify. Delegate workers for at most 2 passes. Export detailed telemetry out of band; return a compact schema. Checkpoint after each pass.

# Lead
Preflight, discover once, plan, build, and verify. Delegate workers for at most 2 passes. Reuse the discovery index; return a compact result schema and checkpoint each pass.

# Coordinator
The coordinator performs preflight, discovery, planning, build, and verification. Repeat build and verification until complete.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Retry at most 3 times and checkpoint after every attempt.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Retry at most 3 times. Stop successfully when tests pass; after the final failure, report the failure summary and escalate to the owner.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Retry at most 3 times. Stop successfully when tests pass; after the final failure, report the failure summary and escalate to the owner. If the failing-check set is unchanged after an attempt, stop and escalate with the evidence path. Checkpoint a bounded summary schema containing objective and scope, approved decisions, progress, blockers and open choices, obligation IDs and evidence paths, plus the next decision.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Retry at most 4 times while the failing-check set shrinks. Stop successfully when tests pass; after final failure report the failure summary and escalate. If failures stop shrinking, stop and escalate. Checkpoint a bounded summary schema containing objective and scope, approved decisions, progress, blockers and open choices, obligation IDs and evidence paths, plus the next decision.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Retry at most 4 times. Stop successfully when tests pass; after final failure report the failure summary and escalate. Continue only for changed diagnostic evidence or a new hypothesis; with no new evidence or hypothesis, stop and escalate. Checkpoint a bounded summary schema containing objective and scope, approved decisions, progress, blockers and open choices, obligation IDs and evidence paths, plus the next decision.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Use one ordinary RED -> GREEN step: observe the failing test, implement once, and stop successfully when it passes; on failure report the summary and escalate.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Retry a known flaky check at most 2 times. Stop successfully on pass; on final failure report the summary and escalate. If the failure signature is unchanged, stop early and escalate. Checkpoint a bounded summary schema containing objective and scope, approved decisions, progress, blockers and open choices, obligation IDs and evidence paths, plus the next decision.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Iterate over an enumerated matrix of 5 compiler options, record each result once, and summarize the completed matrix; this is not a repair retry.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Retry until tests pass.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Iterate at most 2 times; checkpoint and summarize after each iteration.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Iterate at most 2 times. After each iteration checkpoint a bounded summary schema containing objective and scope, approved decisions, progress, blockers and open choices, obligation IDs and evidence paths, plus the next decision.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Proceed with broad implementation across the repository while implementation scope and acceptance criteria remain TBD.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify the requested narrow change.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, and plan. Classify requirements as must, out of scope, or unknown. Give each unknown an owner, default, and acceptance check; implement only must items, then verify.

# Lead
Preflight and discover. Scope is TBD, so before implementation run a bounded 2-pass discovery spike with a named question, owner, and exit criterion; then plan, build, and verify only the resolved scope.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, plan, build, and verify. Iterate at most 2 times. Checkpoint a bounded summary schema containing objective and scope, decisions, progress, blockers and open choices, obligation IDs and evidence paths, plus the next decision.

# Lead
Preflight, discover, and plan. Proceed with broad implementation only from the resolved packet while initial scope and acceptance remain TBD: classify every requirement as must, out of scope, or unknown, and give each unknown an owner, default, and acceptance check. Then build and verify only must items.

# Lead
Preflight and discover. Proceed with broad implementation only after scope TBD is resolved by a bounded 2-pass discovery spike with a named question, owner, and exit criterion; then plan, build, and verify the resolved scope.
